OUR STORY

Why "Gateway"?

✎ THIS IS WHERE YOUR AIM / MISSION STATEMENT GOES — replace the paragraph below with your own words. Keep it roughly 60–90 words, 1 short paragraph, in first-person "we" voice.

We named ourselves Gateway because that's exactly what we set out to be — the first, warmest welcome you find as you enter Asansol, and the finest one you'll want to return to. Every plate that leaves our kitchen is built on that promise: familiar flavours, generous portions, and a room designed to make ordinary evenings feel a little more special. Whether you're stopping in for breakfast, a family dinner, or a late-night craving, our aim is simple — good food, great ambience, better memories, every single time.

Multi-cuisine kitchen — Indian, Tandoor & Indo-Chinese
Dine-in, takeaway & delivery on Zomato and Swiggy
Long-table seating built for family gatherings

THE ROOM

Pastel walls,
peacock stories,
plush seating.

Our dining room was designed to slow you down — hand-painted chinoiserie panels, blush stripes, teal velvet chairs and marble underfoot. It's the kind of interior our guests photograph before they've even ordered.
